meta.title: Chimney Liner Installation Toronto | Northmark Chimney
meta.description: Chimney liner inspection and replacement in Toronto & the GTA. Stainless liners sized to your fireplace, stove or furnace. Free inspection with photos.

hero.p: The liner carries heat and smoke up and out, and protects the rest of the chimney from them. When it cracks or breaks up, it needs attention. We check it with a camera, show you what we find, and reline with stainless steel sized to your appliance when that is what it needs.
hero.t-4: Draft tested — before we call it done

faq.q: What does a chimney liner actually do?
faq.p-2: It carries heat and combustion gases safely up and out, protecting the surrounding masonry and your home’s structure. It needs to be intact.
faq.q-2: How do I know my liner is failing?
faq.p-3: Tile fragments in the firebox, poor draft, visible cracks, or a flagged home-sale inspection. The free inspection confirms the condition with photos.
faq.p-4: Stainless is what we install for relining: durable, correctly sized, and suitable for most appliances. We’ll explain the trade-offs for your setup.
faq.p-5: Yes — an oversized or undersized liner drafts poorly. Sizing to the appliance is most of the job.
faq.q-5: How much does a new liner cost?
faq.p-6: It depends on the chimney’s height, the appliance and access, so we price it after the free inspection — at your home, before any work starts.
